Title: Limits the taxation on individuals in the year in which they turn sixty-five years of age
Summary: Limits the taxation on individuals in the year in which they turn sixty-five years of age; imposes not more than a $1,000 fine and disqualifies the applicant from further real property tax freezes for a period of five years where an applicant made a wilful false statement in the aquisition of such real property tax freeze.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the real property tax law, in relation to the limitation of taxation on certain seniors
